messages.subject: Some models not converging..any thoughts?
parts:
Hi,

I have a 2x latent factor SEM model (identified).  I have 4x reflective indicators for each factor, a correlation between the 2x latent factors and 2x regression paths between the latent factors and the DV.  The observed variables are standardised and normally distributed i.e., mean = 0 for all observed variables:

Model:
L1=~ v1 + v2 + v3 + v4
L2 =~ v5 + v6 +v7+ v8
DV ~ L1 + L2

I am testing this model with a series of input correlation matrices where each matrix has slightly different values for v5, v6, and v7.  The values for v5, v6 and v7 are selected at random with values anywhere between a min/max correlation value of 0.1 and 0.3, however, matrices that demonstrate high multi-collinearity are discarded and not used. All manifest variables have a fixed correlation in the matrices with the DV throughout all the matrices and the other manifest/observable variable values also stay fixed.

The problem is that half of my models converge, and the half do not.  Running comparisons tests on the matrices for the converged and non-converged models, I can see that there is no difference in VIF/Tolerance. no difference in min or max. eigen values, no difference in condition codes and no difference in the determinants of the matrices, which all leads me to believe that I am not suffering from multicollinearity issues amongst the non-converging group of matrices.  However, I am now out of ideas of what the difference between the converging group of matrices and non-converging group of matrices might be?

Is it just the case that the model is simply not suitable for half of these values within this range, or I am missing something with the characteristics of the input correlation matrices?

Any thoughts would be greatly appreciated! 
Thanks!
Dan

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Some models not converging..any thoughts?
parts:
Hi Dan,

To improve convergence, try using the bounds= argument. Start with
bounds = TRUE, which is the same as bounds = "wide". Other options are
bounds = "standard", and bounds = "pos.var".

As for why some models convergence, while others do not: that is a great
question for which (AFAIK) there is no solid answer yet.

Yves.
